_comment: Stories for evals/generation_quality.py, written against evals/targets/ui_demo_app.py. planted_bug_criteria = the criteria the demo app breaks on purpose: a good set of cases must FAIL there and nowhere else. | 2026-10-23: 3 stories. 'notes' has the planted bug (AC-2); 'logout' and 'delayed-save' are healthy, so a failing case there is a false failure.

stories.story:
As a user I keep short notes in my account.
Test user: demo / demo123 (log in at /login).
- A logged-in user can add a note and then sees it in the notes list
- An empty note is rejected with the message 'Note cannot be empty'
- A wrong password shows 'Invalid username or password' and the user stays on the login page
- After logging in, the dashboard greets the user with 'Welcome, demo'

As a user I can end my session.
Test user: demo / demo123 (log in at /login).
- A logged-in user who opens /logout is taken back to the login page, which shows the heading 'Log in'
- After logging out, opening /dashboard does not show the dashboard: the user is sent to the login page
- Logging in again with the same user works and the dashboard greets the user with 'Welcome, demo'

As a user I save a setting on the page /delayed (no login needed).
- Before the Save button is clicked the page shows no 'Saved!' message
- Clicking Save shows the message 'Saved!' a moment later, without leaving the page
- After saving, the page is still /delayed
